description: This file defines the TaskRepository class, which provides CRUD operations for Task objects, backed by a TaskDataSource. It exposes methods to get, add, update, delete, and toggle completion status of tasks.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: A class that manages task data, providing CRUD functionalities and interacting with a data source.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tasks from the data source.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the list and saves it.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task by its ID.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task by its ID.
